body: > [!IMPORTANT] > Takes with camera-off gaps get a different export fingerprint every time they are seeded, so "already exported → reuse" stops matching for them. One smaller timing issue in the gap log is also inline. **Reviewed changes** I reviewed all four commits: the main-process change from destroy to park, the renderer camera relay, gap tracking in the store and sidecar, and the editor seeding. - **Bubble parks instead of being destroyed**: during a take that records a webcam file, turning the camera off now hides and keeps the bubble window (`park()`), and it is released at finalize, abort, stop or reset. - **Bubble preview follows the Camera toggle**: `useCameraOn()` makes the hidden window release its own camera stream. - **Webcam relay**: the encoder reads a `MediaStreamTrackGenerator` that is fed through a `MediaStreamTrackProcessor`. It uses an explicit `frameRate` and `sizeChangeBehavior: "contain"`, and `turnWebcamOff` / `turnWebcamOn` handle supersession and timeouts. - **Gap log in the store**: each off period is recorded in screen ms on the take's pause-aware clock. A failed re-open ends the file and shows the existing notice after the take. - **Sidecar `webcam.gaps`**: these are sanitized (clamped, sorted, merged, capped) in `webcam-track.ts`. - **Editor seeding**: `seedWebcamScene` turns each gap into a hidden segment. Short gaps are stretched to the minimum segment length and kept inside the recording.   ｜ [Fix all ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog/1?action=fix&review_id=5730243538) ｜ [Fix 👍s ➔](https://pullfrog.com/trigger/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog/1?action=fix-approved&review_id=5730243538) ｜ [View workflow run](https://github.com/niway-dev/kaipu-bench-pullfrog/actions/runs/41349360360/job/124975989043) ｜ Using `claude-opus-5-5` ｜ [𝕏](https://x.com/pullfrogai)
